name: Wind River — Dubois to Dinwoody Creek
gaugeName: Wind River Above Red Creek, Near Dubois, WY (USGS 06220800)
blurb: Wind River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points (some reaches have federal or tribal rules; see notes).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Dubois City Park (Wind): approximate agency-documented access area. Take-out Painted Hills (Wind): approximate area only. Wind River Indian Reservation: non-members need a tribal permit to "camp, hike, boat, and picnic" plus a $20 Recreation Stamp; every person in a boat or raft must wear a USCG life jacket, and all non-members in the boat must hold a valid permit. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. The former 15.9-mile figure is invalid after correcting the park location. Only the approximate access areas are shown while route distance is reviewed.
sections.distanceReview: The town’s official park location corrects an upstream agency marker error. The old 15.9-mile route started at that incorrect point; distance and timing are withheld until the corrected reach is measured.

putInAccess.sourceName: Town of Dubois — Dubois Town Park
putInAccess.note: The WGFD site name is corroborated by the town, but the original WGFD coordinate is roughly 10 km northwest of the actual park. Replaced with the town’s own facility-area coordinate, corroborated by imagery. Exact landing and revised downstream mileage remain unverified.
putInAccess.directions: Use Dubois Town Park at 10 Bighorn Lane. The town lists river access and parking; this marker identifies the park area, not a vehicle boat ramp. Confirm a suitable carrying route and landing on site. Overnight camping is prohibited.

takeOutAccess.operator: Wyoming Game and Fish Department (Public Access Area)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish Department — River Access Points (All_River_Access_Points/FeatureServer/0)
takeOutAccess.note: Boating access is documented by WGFD River Access Points OBJECTID 126 ('Painted Hills', listed as a launch and take-out). The coordinate is WGFD Public Access Area facilities (PAA_Facilities/FeatureServer/3), OBJECTID 23932 'Wind River-Painted Hills: Painted Hills' (Parking), 28 m from the WGFD point; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: no agency boat-facility point within 100 m; coordinate is a nearby agency access/parking feature.
takeOutAccess.directions: Approximate area only: the Painted Hills access listed by Wyoming Game and Fish, at or near the agency feature 'Wind River-Painted Hills: Painted Hills'. Locate the launch on site; stay on public ground — the streambed and banks next to private land are private.

sections.notes: Put-in Stoney Point (Wind): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Take-out Painted Hills (Wind): approximate area only. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (8.6 mi); no agency mileage found.
